title: 色彩缤纷的手工雕塑
prompt: A colorful handcrafted sculpture of [insert subject], made from semi-transparent ice blocks in custom shapes. Accents like icing, candy, yarn, or fruit skin enhance facial features, texture, or accessories. Placed on a ceramic plate over a leaf or decorative mat, with a clean, softly lit studio or natural tabletop background. Lighting highlights the glossy ice texture, blending food art, toy design, and photography into a playful, artistic composition.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 拍摄色彩缤纷的手工雕塑，突出半透明冰块的光泽质感，适合美食艺术、玩具设计和商业摄影，在柔和光照下呈现生动创意风格。
